result.summary: The food delivery home screen renders mostly correctly, but one clear defect is visible: a section heading shows a raw localization key instead of translated text. No other visual breakage was found; the partially visible carousel items and bottom card are expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: The second section heading displays the untranslated i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title (e.g. 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for 'home_feed.popular_title' to the locale files and ensure a fallback string is shown when a key is missing.
